Gleam 10000 MAH MagSafe Power Bank with 15W Wireless Charger

The Gleam 10000 MAH MagSafe Power Bank is a powerful, compact, and future-ready charging solution designed for users who demand speed, convenience, and versatility. Equipped with a 15W wireless charger, a high-capacity 10,000mAh battery, and built-in Type-C and Lightning cables, this premium power bank delivers seamless charging for smartphones, smartwatches, and wireless-enabled devices—anytime, anywhere.

Built for modern lifestyles, the Gleam MagSafe power bank supports magnetic wireless charging, ensuring a stable and efficient connection for compatible devices. Whether you are traveling, working remotely, or attending meetings, this MagSafe-compatible power bank keeps your devices powered without the hassle of carrying multiple chargers.

High-Speed Wireless & Wired Charging in One Device

Experience next-level convenience with the 15W wireless fast charging that delivers reliable performance while maintaining device safety. The integrated Type-C and Lightning cables eliminate the need for extra accessories, making it an ideal choice for users who value portability and clutter-free charging.

With a robust 10,000mAh battery capacity, this wireless can charge most smartphones multiple times on a single cycle. It is optimized for efficiency, ensuring consistent power delivery while protecting devices against overheating, overcharging, and short circuits.

Dedicated Smartwatch Charging Support

The 2.5W smartwatch charger is specially designed to provide safe and stable charging for smartwatches. This makes the Gleam 10000 MAH MagSafe a true all-in-one charging hub, capable of powering smartphones, wireless earbuds, and wearables with ease.

Key Features

  • 10,000mAh high-capacity battery for extended power backup
  • 15W wireless fast charging with MagSafe compatibility
  • Built-in Type-C cable for fast and reliable wired charging
  • Built-in Lightning cable for Apple devices
  • 2.5W dedicated smartwatch charging output
  • Magnetic alignment for secure and efficient wireless charging
  • Compact, lightweight, and travel-friendly design
  • Advanced safety protection against overcharging and overheating

Ideal for Travel, Work & Corporate Gifting

The Gleam 10000 MAH MagSafe Power Bank is designed for professionals, travelers, and tech-savvy users who need reliable power on the go. Its sleek design and multifunctional charging support make it a popular choice for corporate gifts, employee onboarding kits, promotional giveaways, and premium tech accessories.

As a versatile wireless power bank with built-in cables, it reduces dependency on wall chargers and tangled wires. This makes it perfect for daily commuting, business trips, and long travel days where access to power outlets is limited.

Why Choose Gleam 10000 MAH MagSafe Power Bank?

Unlike standard, this MagSafe-enabled model combines wireless charging, wired output, and smartwatch support in a single compact unit. The intelligent power management system ensures optimal charging speed while extending battery lifespan.

Whether you are looking for a 10,000mAh wireless power bank, a MagSafe charger for iPhone, or a multi-device charging solution, the Gleam delivers exceptional performance and long-term value.

Product Highlights at a Glance

  • All-in-one MagSafe power bank with wireless and wired charging
  • Supports smartphones, smartwatches, and wireless accessories
  • Fast 15W wireless charging for compatible devices
  • Premium build quality with modern, minimalist design
  • Perfect for personal use, travel, and corporate gifting

Upgrade your charging experience with the a reliable, stylish, and powerful solution designed to keep your devices charged wherever life takes you.
